collected_dynamic_variables.pain_points: we're so busy, it's chaos and I don't track how many missed calls we have, worried missed calls go to other agents
collected_dynamic_variables.pain_frame: we're so busy, it's chaos and I don't track how many missed calls we have

transcript:
User: Hey! So I'm Sofia — I run a real estate office here in Houston. Your ad was talking about missed calls? That's literally me.
Agent: Nice to meet you, Sofia — yeah, that’s exactly who we were talking to. So when you say “that’s literally me,” what’s been happening with missed calls at your office?
User: I don't track that... maybe 25? Or 30? Who knows! We're so busy, it's chaos.
Agent: Got it, that totally lines up with what we hear from busy offices. When one of those calls comes in and no one grabs it — does it usually just hit voicemail, or are people calling back later, or… do they just disappear to another agent?
User: They usually hit voicemail, but I worry they just disappear to other agents. We can't have that!
Agent: Yeah, that makes total sense — in real estate, one missed call can be a whole commission walking away. Roughly how many calls a week would you say are going to voicemail right now, even if it’s just a guess?
User: I mean, 25. Or was it 30? Who can keep track? It's a lot, though!
Agent: Yeah, that’s a lot — and in your world, those are real buyers and listings, not just “calls.” Has anyone ever actually walked you through what that kind of volume of missed calls is costing you in commissions?
User: No one's broken it down like that, but I know it's costing me a ton in lost opportunities.
Agent: Totally hear you — most offices feel it in their gut but never see the actual numbers. So, ballpark, if you think about a typical week: how many of those calls hitting voicemail — say out of that 25–30 — would’ve actually turned into a real client if someone picked up live?
User: Probably half, I’d say. Maybe more. It’s a guessing game, but I bet we’re missing big opportunities.
Agent: Gotcha, that helps — even half is huge in real estate. And when you do land someone from one of those calls, what’s a typical commission check look like for you on an average deal?
User: Oh, it can be anywhere from $5,000 to $15,000, depending on the deal size. Big money!
Agent: Yeah, exactly — that adds up fast; on your numbers you’re leaking well over two hundred grand a month in potential deals just from missed calls. So… it’s a quick 20‑minute walkthrough where we plug in your real numbers and show how to stop that leak — would later today or tomorrow work better for you?
User: I'm busy next week... actually, tomorrow works! Tell me more — this is exactly what I need.
Agent: Love it — tomorrow is perfect. And Sofia, what’s your last name so I can note it correctly?
User: Oops, almost forgot! It's Sofia Martinez. Tomorrow works, but just to confirm — what time again?
Agent: Got it, Sofia Martinez, thank you. Before we lock in a time for tomorrow, is the number you’re calling from the best one to send a quick text confirmation to?
User: Yes, this number is perfect. But wait, did we decide on a time? I need to double-check!
Agent: You’re right, we haven’t picked an exact time yet — thanks for catching that. For tomorrow I can get you in as soon as Wednesday at 2:00 pm or 5:00 pm Central; which one works better for you?
User: Oh wait, I think I meant tomorrow as Thursday! Can we do Thursday at 2:00 pm Central instead?
Agent: Gotcha, thanks for clarifying — Thursday at 2:00 pm Central works. Just to confirm out loud: you’re set for this Thursday at 2:00 pm your time; does that still fit your schedule?
User: Yes, Thursday 2:00 pm Central works perfectly. Just need you to confirm it's all set one more time!
Agent: Perfect, we’re locked in for Thursday at 2:00 pm Central. Before we wrap, can you read me the full phone number you want tied to the booking, digits only, so I make sure everything’s saved correctly?
User: Sure thing! It's 713-555-0199. Thanks for confirming the time; I’m looking forward to fixing this chaos!
Agent: Got it, thanks — I’ve got your number as 713‑555‑0199. One last thing before we wrap: on Thursday at 2:00, will it just be you on the demo, or do you want any of your agents or admin staff to join too?
User: It'll just be me, for now. I want to make sure it's a fit before involving everyone else.
Agent: Makes sense, starting with you is perfect. Quick thing and then you’re totally set: can you say your number once more but as if you were giving it for a form — country code first, so for example “1‑713‑555‑0199”?
User: Sure thing! It's +1-713-555-0199. Thanks for making sure everything's in order. Can't wait to get started!
Agent: Thanks, Sofia — you’re all set for Thursday at 2:00 pm Central, and you’ll get a text with the details so you can add it to your calendar or reschedule if anything changes. Really glad you called today; Jay’s looking forward to meeting you and cleaning up those missed-call headaches, have a great rest of your day!
